description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the JobCategoryAPI in the OrangeHRM system, focusing on testing various REST API endpoints related to job categories, including get all, get one, create, update, and delete operations.

classes.name: JobCategoryAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the REST API endpoints provided by JobCategoryAPI in OrangeHRM's admin module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, truncates the JobCategory table, and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'get all job categories' API endpoint using provided test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the 'get all' operation, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'get one job category' API endpoint with specified test parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'get one' API operation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new job category via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'create' API operation from YAML data.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing job category through the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'update' API operation.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a job category via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'delete' API operation.
